offer_name: First Ascent, a six-week beginner bouldering course (example)
headline: Climb your first V3 in six weeks
proof: 71% of the spring cohort sent a V3 by week six (gym logbook)
Before-and-after videos from 12 past participants, shared with consent

obstacles.text: I am not strong enough to start
I do not know the technique and feel watched
Shoes and chalk are an upfront cost before I know I like it
I will drop off after two sessions
I am afraid of falling and getting hurt

components.name: Open-floor pass for the six weeks
Buddy matching and weekly progress check

guarantee.terms: Attend all six sessions; if you do not want to keep climbing, the course fee is refunded in full.

urgency.reason: Each cohort is capped at 8 people per coach and starts on a fixed date.
